name: CIRCL Passive DNS
tagline: Free historical DNS lookup for domain and IP investigations
description: CIRCL Passive DNS is a free passive DNS service from the Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg that stores historical DNS resolution records. Investigators can query domains, reverse-query IPs, and retrieve associated resource records for threat hunting, malware analysis, and incident response. Access typically requires authentication; response formats and rate limits are documented on the official service pages.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Access is restricted to approved trusted partners; CIRCL publishes no numerical usage quota or general eligibility guarantee.

find domains that resolved to a given IP
enrich IOC investigations with passive DNS history
